property_summary: When this test contract is not the jojoTeam address, calling newEmergencyOracle must revert (original checks msg.sender), but the mutant (checking tx.origin) can succeed when an external EOAs origin matches jojoTeam — so for all callers where jojoTeam != address(this) the call reverts.
change_summary: Change the onlyJojoTeam modifier to require tx.origin instead of msg.sender, altering which callers pass the check and thus potentially changing whether newEmergencyOracle call succeeds and sets newOracle.
